title: Frames
description: Fleet telemetry from the frame heartbeat payloads in Loki, filterable per frame and firmware.

list.label: Frame

list.description: Substring filter for the raw heartbeat payloads panel.

targets.expr: avg(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap cpu_usage_percent [$__range]) by (serial_number))

avg(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format ram_used_percent=`{{ mulf (divf (subf (float64 .ram_total_bytes) (float64 .ram_available_bytes)) (float64 .ram_total_bytes)) 100 }}` | unwrap ram_used_percent [$__range]) by (serial_number))

avg(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap cpu_temp_celsius [$__range]) by (serial_number))

panels.title: Frames reporting

targets.expr: count(count by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [$__range])))

panels.description: Distinct frames that sent a telemetry heartbeat in the range.

panels.title: Silent frames

targets.expr: (count(count by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [$__range]))) - count(count by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [15m])))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames that reported somewhere in the range but nothing in the last 15 minutes. The heartbeat interval is 5 minutes.

panels.title: Unhealthy

targets.expr: (count(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format healthy=`{{ if eq .health_state "ok" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap healthy [$__range]) by (serial_number)) - sum(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format healthy=`{{ if eq .health_state "ok" }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap healthy [$__range]) by (serial_number))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames whose most recent heartbeat reported health_state other than ok.

panels.title: Service down

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format service_down=`{{ if or (eq .dashboard_running "false") (eq .display_running "false") (eq .update_running "false") (eq .websocket_running "false") }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | unwrap service_down [$__range]) by (serial_number)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Frames whose last heartbeat reported dashboard, display, update or websocket not running.

panels.title: Reboots in range

targets.expr: sum(max_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap boot_count [$__range]) by (serial_number) - min_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap boot_count [$__range]) by (serial_number))

panels.description: Every field the frame reports, from its most recent heartbeat. Rows are sorted by Last seen before grouping, so a frame that changed firmware, IP or kernel inside the range collapses to its newest values instead of an arbitrary older row. time_iso is omitted: it changes each heartbeat, so it cannot be a column without minting a series per heartbeat.

panels.title: Heartbeat presence

targets.expr: sum by (serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [$__interval]))

panels.description: One cell per 5-minute bucket. A gap is a frame that sent nothing in that bucket.

panels.title: Websocket connections

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "New connection accepted" [$__interval]))
sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "Connection disconnected" [$__interval]))
sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "Connection rejected" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Fleet-wide. These lines identify frames by database id, not serial, so the frame filter does not apply to them.

panels.title: Disconnect close codes

targets.expr: sum by (close_code) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="websockets.frames"} |= "Connection disconnected" | regexp `with code (?P<close_code>\d+)` [$__interval]))

panels.description: 1000 is a clean close, 1006 an abnormal drop.

panels.title: Stale connections reaped

targets.expr: sum (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="celery.frames"} |= "Closed and deleted" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Connections the Celery reaper closed after the inactivity timeout.

panels.title: Firmware versions

targets.expr: count by (fw_version) (count by (fw_version, serial_number) (count_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} [$__range])))

panels.description: Frames per firmware version in the range.

panels.description: A drop back to zero is a reboot.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | unwrap cpu_temp_celsius [$__auto]) by (serial_number)

panels.description: How the fleet's temperatures are spread over time, not just the per-frame lines.

panels.title: Temperature vs CPU usage

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format metric="CPU %" | unwrap cpu_usage_percent [$__range]) by (serial_number, metric)

panels.description: One point per frame: hot frames that are not busy point at a cooling or placement problem.

targets.expr: last_over_time({job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}` | json | label_format storage_used_percent=`{{ mulf (subf 1.0 (divf (float64 .storage_data_free_bytes) (float64 .storage_data_total_bytes))) 100 }}` | unwrap storage_used_percent [$__range]) by (serial_number)

panels.title: Frame API requests

targets.expr: sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="django.request"} | regexp `(?:GET|POST) /api/(?P<endpoint>frames/[a-z-]+|frame-updates/[a-z-]+)/` | endpoint != "" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Token, OTP, registration, send-image and OTA calls. Fleet-wide, these lines carry no serial label.

panels.title: Signature auth failures

targets.expr: sum by (serial) (count_over_time({job="backend", logger="frames.auth"} |= "Signature auth failed" | regexp `for frame (?P<serial>\S+):` | serial != "" [$__range]))

panels.description: Ed25519 signature rejections per frame serial over the range. The only non-heartbeat stream that carries the serial.

panels.title: Heartbeat payloads

targets.expr: {job="backend", serial_number=~"$frame", fw_version=~"$fw"} |= "$search" | regexp `log - b'(?P<payload>\{.*\})'$` | line_format `{{.payload}}`

panels.description: The raw telemetry JSON each frame posted. Use Search to grep it.
